reported_cause_or_request: The shelves are full and I keep buying food I already have.
observed_context: Several unopened duplicates are behind opaque containers; weekly bulk purchases continue; no inventory check occurs before shopping.

reported_cause_or_request: The organizer will not sit inside the drawer.
observed_context: The drawer is 3 inches high; the organizer is 4 inches high; only width was measured before purchase.

training_only_case: We need a larger key organizer.
reported_cause_or_request: Keys and mail pile on the kitchen counter.
observed_context: The existing organizer is beside the front door; everyone enters through the garage next to the kitchen.

reported_cause_or_request: Family members return items to different shelves.
observed_context: Each person uses different category names; all can reach the shelves; no shared placement rule exists.

training_only_case: The pantry needs a complete redesign.
reported_cause_or_request: It looks organized for three days and then collapses.
observed_context: New groceries have no assigned intake step; several containers must be unstacked and unlidded during every reset.

reported_cause_or_request: A plastic storage bin cracked and the stack collapsed.
observed_context: The bin was used within its stated load and cracked at the same hinge as two earlier units.

reported_cause_or_request: Stored items are damp and smell musty.
observed_context: Water staining is visible beneath an exterior-wall seam; moisture returns after rain; possible visible growth is present.

training_only_case: The whole house needs an organization system.
reported_cause_or_request: Boxes cover one room after a holiday delivery week.
observed_context: The home was functional before the deliveries; every box has a known destination; the backlog is four days old.

training_only_case: Floor bins are the only storage that fits.
reported_cause_or_request: An older resident must step around bins in a hallway.
observed_context: The route is narrow; two near-falls occurred; the resident has difficulty bending and lifting.

reported_cause_or_request: The owner wants matching containers.
observed_context: Every item is found quickly; nothing expires; weekly resets succeed; no safety time waste or access consequence is reported.

reported_cause_or_request: Craft materials no longer fit in the room.
observed_context: More than half have not been used in two years; new materials arrive monthly; existing cabinets are correctly measured and full.

training_only_case: I need to stop buying duplicates.
reported_cause_or_request: Food expires unseen in deep opaque bins.
observed_context: Purchases are made without checking contents; when items are moved to visible shallow zones duplicate buying drops.

reported_cause_or_request: A daily appliance is stored on a high shelf across the room.
observed_context: Unused serving pieces occupy the point-of-use cabinet; retrieving the appliance requires a stool twice daily.

training_only_case: I need sealed containers under the sink.
reported_cause_or_request: Supplies become wet after each dishwasher cycle.
observed_context: A pipe connection drips during operation; the cabinet base is swollen; the leak has not been repaired.

reported_cause_or_request: Items no longer match their labels after six months.
observed_context: Household categories changed but labels and shelf assignments were never reviewed; adhesive and printing remain intact.

training_only_case: The toy system works for adults but not the child.
reported_cause_or_request: Toys remain on the floor after play.
observed_context: Bins are above the child's reach and lids require more grip strength than the child has; the child can use an open floor-level basket.

reported_cause_or_request: A new bin fits the width and depth but cannot be removed.
observed_context: The open door and hinge reduce usable clearance; door-swing clearance was not measured.

reported_cause_or_request: Mail and routine items accumulate during weeks with heavy caregiving duties.
observed_context: Available storage is adequate and item volume is stable; the system requires sorting into nine categories before anything can be put away.

training_only_case: I need an organizer for this closet.
reported_cause_or_request: The only information supplied is one photograph of a full closet.
observed_context: No inventory dimensions frequency consequences users or workarounds are provided.

training_only_case: I need a bigger shoe rack.
reported_cause_or_request: Shoes block the only exit path.
observed_context: The rack holds its rated quantity; additional shoes sit in the egress route; the household reports no alternative exit.
